guidance: BUILD-AWARE INDEX: this project has a ByteAsk index built from its real compile commands, one per build setting. To find where a C/C++ symbol is defined or used, which template versions a build really compiles, whether an #if branch is live, or how a file is compiled, call the context_* tools before grepping or reading headers by hand: they answer per build setting and mark answers that are only approximate. For a bug report, issue or change request, call context_bundle first with the full task text (example code, errors and stack traces included): it says where the change most likely belongs and why, with the code, what it calls, what calls it and the tests that exercise it (context_pack is the older, smaller version). context_find, context_hierarchy and context_calls answer exact definition, inheritance and call questions, overloads and virtual calls included; context_example shows what a piece of example code really executes in this project; after a fix the tests confirm, record the lesson with context_remember. Every answer names its build setting and commit; when it says the index is behind your worktree, read the edited files themselves before relying on it.
